places.chef: owner, baker · Tokyo (transplant to Nagano) · Pinatis was opened in June 2019 by a baker who relocated from Tokyo to Nagano's historic Zenko-ji gate district. The owner personally searched the neighborhood on foot for the right property, settling on a renovated old house in the quiet residential enclave of Hanasaki-cho. The shop runs just three days a week — Thursday through Saturday — with the baker working through the night listening to the radio to have fresh loaves ready by around 9:30 AM. · No added sugar or oil in the core breads; ingredient-forward simplicity. The wild-yeast culture rotates with the seasons, giving the bread a subtly different character throughout the year.
